Job Summary:

The Analyst or Senior Analyst will be responsible for designing and delivering impactful learning solutions that build internal product capability, drive organizational effectiveness, and enable talent readiness. This role involves strategic planning, instructional design, LMS/LXP knowledge, facilitation, stakeholder engagement, and leveraging analytics to measure learning impact. The candidate will play a key role in creating personalised learning and career pathways aligned with organizational priorities, lead enrollment on the open learning calendar & must be well organized, detail oriented and possess excellent communication skills.

Key Responsibilities:

  •    Develop and implement a comprehensive learning strategy aligned with organizational goals and objectives
    ● Conduct Training Needs Analysis to identify skill gaps and develop targeted training programs
    ● Engage with stakeholders, including Leaders, Managers and ICs to understand their learning needs and map it with business metrics
    ● Lead the planning and execution of open enrollment calendar, management development programs and other L&D initiatives aligned with business priorities
    ● Collaborate with stakeholders to identify capability gaps and design targeted learning journeys for emerging and experienced resources
    ● Create structured learning journeys, microlearning modules, and blended learning experiences. Incorporate case studies, simulations, and real-world scenarios for experiential learning.

    ● Coordinate and facilitate training programs
    ● Act as a trusted advisor to business leaders, translating strategic priorities into development interventions. Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders and external vendors to deliver customized solutions.
    ● Review and validate product training materials created by the project consultants
    ● Create and maintain standard product training materials for new or updated HighRadius products
    ● Deliver soft-skills training to consulting-wide teams
    ● Collaborate with cross functional teams such as consulting, product, and support to ensure all training content is updated and accurate
    ● Prior knowledge of various phases of project life cycle including Design, Build, Testing, cutover, Go-live and hyper care
    ● Prior knowledge and experience of training delivery and content creation
    ● Prior knowledge of Order to Cash process will be a plus
    ● Prior experience with training clients on SaaS products will be a plus

Job Specification:

  • ● Overall 3-6 years of professional services experience.
    ● Bachelor's or Master’s Degree (preferably from tier 1 or tier 2 institutes).
    ● Location: Hyderabad.
    ● Mandatory: Good communication skills, Excellent Time Management skills, Good Analytical Skills, Good problem solving skills, Good presentation skills, Organizational skills, Collaboration skills, Conflict Resolution skills, Training Aptitude, Technical Inclination, Stakeholder Management, Team Player.
    ● Desirable: Exposure to international clients / projects, Exposure to Functional consulting roles
    ● Experience in following the established processes/standards/templates to achieve successful results.

What You’ll Get

  • ● Competitive salary.
    ● Fun-filled work culture (https://www.highradius.com/culture/)
    ● Equal employment opportunities.
    ● Opportunity to build with a pre-IPO Global SaaS Centaur.

Job Description

Job Purpose: Serve as a key business analyst supporting the design and delivery of global sales systems and processes. This role is accountable for translating business needs into detailed system requirements, epics, user stories, and use cases. The analyst will work closely with Sales, IT, and cross-functional teams to ensure that platform enhancements and new capabilities are well-defined, prioritised, and aligned to business goals. 

Principal Accountabilities 

• 
Requirements Gathering & Analysis: Lead discovery sessions with stakeholders to understand business needs and translate them into clear, actionable system requirements. 

• 
Process Design & Documentation: Map current and future state sales processes, identifying gaps and opportunities for simplification and automation. 

• 
User Stories & Epics: Write high-quality epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria to support Agile delivery, ensuring traceability from business need to technical implementation. 

• 
Use Case Development: Create detailed use cases and process flows to support solution design and user experience improvements. 

• 
Backlog Management: Partner with Product Owners and IT to manage the backlog, prioritise features, and support sprint planning and refinement sessions. 

• 
Testing & Validation: Support UAT planning and execution, ensuring that delivered functionality meets business requirements and is fit for purpose. 

• 
Stakeholder Engagement: Act as a liaison between business users and technical teams, ensuring alignment and shared understanding throughout the delivery lifecycle. 

Measures of Success 

• 
High-quality, complete, and timely documentation of business requirements and user stories 

• 
Strong alignment between business needs and delivered system capabilities 

• 
Improved process efficiency and user satisfaction with sales platforms 

• 
Reduced rework and change requests due to clear and validated requirements 

• 
Effective collaboration across business and technical teams
